title: Rename the project Apricitus → Apricity (code, crates, packages, manifests, docs) and publish to AnthusAI/Apricity
description: User request (2026-09-24 morning): rename to Apricity and publish publicly at github.com/AnthusAI/Apricity. Scope: every tracked file except project/ (the Kanbus IDs are renamed separately by the new `kbs rekey`, filed in Kanbus); path renames (crates/apricity-*, analysis/apricity_analyze, *.apricity.json manifests, web/src/apricity.ts, contract/apricity.contract.json); content Apricitus/apricitus/APRICITUS → Apricity/apricity/APRICITY; regenerate the contract and Cargo.lock. Verification: cargo test --workspace, the wasm build and tests, tsc, the tsx data tests, the web build, pytest analysis/tests, npm run contract:check, and git grep -i apricitus empty outside project/. Then create the public repo AnthusAI/Apricity and push master. The local folder rename (~/Projects/Ripple → ~/Projects/Apricity) is done by the user at the end.
